OutputCOP.description:
Coefficients of performance for space heating & cooling, and hot water systems.
Null-values are used when a divide-by-zero occurs in the results. These are output as "DIV/0" in the CSVs.

space_heating_system.description: Overall coefficient of performance for each heating system (unitless)
space_heating_system.title: Space Heating System

space_cooling_system.description: Overall coefficient of performance for each heating system (unitless)
space_cooling_system.title: Space Cooling System

hot_water_system.description: Overall coefficient of performance for each heating system (unitless)
hot_water_system.title: Hot Water System

OutputCOP.title: OutputCOP

OutputCore.description:
The raw HEM Core outputs, from Project.run()

For the _unmet_demand energy supply object, end-uses are:
    - space heating or cooling per zone, where the naming convention is _unmet_demand: [zone name from input]
    - water heating unmet demand, where the naming convention is _unmet_demand: [hot water source names from input]

For all other energy supplies, end-use names refer to specific systems or appliances specified in the input file.

timestep_array.description: The list of timesteps, serves as an index for the other outputs (unit: Hours)
timestep_array.title: Timestep Array

results_end_user.description: Energy per supply, per end use (unit: kWh)
results_end_user.title: Results End User

energy_import.description: Total energy imported from the grid, including both direct consumption and battery charging (unit: kWh)
energy_import.title: Energy Import

energy_export.description: Total energy exported to the grid (unit: kWh)
energy_export.title: Energy Export

grid_to_consumption.description: Energy imported from the grid directly to consumption. Does not include grid to battery charging (unit: kWh)
grid_to_consumption.title: Grid To Consumption

generation_to_grid.description: On-site generation immediately exported to the grid (unit: kWh)
generation_to_grid.title: Generation To Grid

energy_generated_consumed.description: On-site generation immediately consumed within the dwelling. Does not include energy via storage or PV diverter (unit: kWh)
energy_generated_consumed.title: Energy Generated Consumed

energy_to_storage.description: Energy from on-site generation to storage. Does not include energy from the grid to storage (unit: kWh)
energy_to_storage.title: Energy To Storage

energy_from_storage.description: Energy discharged from storage to consumption (unit: kWh)
energy_from_storage.title: Energy From Storage

storage_to_grid.description: Total energy exported from storage to grid (unit: kWh)
storage_to_grid.title: Storage To Grid

storage_from_grid.description: Energy imported from the grid to storage. Does not include energy from on-site generation to storage (unit: kWh)
storage_from_grid.title: Storage From Grid

energy_diverted.description: Surplus on-site generation diverted to PV diverter, e.g. immersion heater (unit: kWh)
energy_diverted.title: Energy Diverted

generation_curtailed.description: On-site generation curtailed because grid export reached the export power limit. Neither consumed, stored, diverted nor exported (unit: kWh)
generation_curtailed.title: Generation Curtailed

beta_factor.description: Fraction of on-site generation immediately consumed within the dwelling. Does not include energy to storage or diverters (unit: ratio 0 to 1)
beta_factor.title: Beta Factor

zone_list.description: List of the unique zone names in the zone data
zone_list.title: Zone List

heat_balance_all.description: Heat balance data for each zone.
heat_balance_all.title: Heat Balance All

heat_source_wet_results_annual.description: Annual heat source wet detailed results.
heat_source_wet_results_annual.title: Heat Source Wet Results Annual

OutputEmitters.description: Emitters data for every time step.

energy_demand.description: Net energy output requested from the emitter (unit: kWh). May be negative (between zero and emitter minimum output) when the emitter is below room temperature and would cool the heated space below the heating setpoint if the emitter is not actively heated to reduce heat absorption from the heated space.
energy_demand.title: Energy Demand

temp_emitter_required.description: Required emitter temperature to satisfy zone setpoint (unit: Celsius)
temp_emitter_required.title: Temp Emitter Required

time_heating_start.description: Time at which the emitter begins operating (unit: hours)
time_heating_start.title: Time Heating Start

energy_provided_by_heat_source.description: Energy provided by heat source (unit: kWh)
energy_provided_by_heat_source.title: Energy Provided By Heat Source

temp_emitter_max.description: Maximum temperature the emitter can safely reach (unit: Celsius)
temp_emitter_max.title: Temp Emitter Max

temp_flow_target.description: Desired supply temperature to the emitter (unit: Celsius)
temp_flow_target.title: Temp Flow Target

temp_return_target.description: Desired return temperature from the emitter (unit: Celsius)
temp_return_target.title: Temp Return Target

temp_emitter_max_is_final_temp.description: Whether the maximum emitter temperature is used as the final supply temperature
temp_emitter_max_is_final_temp.title: Temp Emitter Max Is Final Temp

energy_required_from_heat_source.description: Energy required from the heat source (unit: kWh)
energy_required_from_heat_source.title: Energy Required From Heat Source
